content.en: The **United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO)** is a specialized agency of the United Nations headquartered in Vienna, Austria. Its primary objective is to promote and accelerate **industrial development** in developing countries and economies in transition. UNIDO focuses on three thematic priorities: creating shared prosperity, advancing economic competitiveness, and safeguarding the environment.

definition.en: The core mandate of UNIDO, ensuring that industrial growth does not compromise social equity or environmental health.

content.en: UNIDO provides technical assistance to member nations to formulate industrial policies that align with global trade standards.

content.en: Do not confuse UNIDO with the World Trade Organization (WTO); while both deal with trade, UNIDO focuses on the industrial capacity building of nations.
